parsed.name: 文件接口设备
parsed.description: 这是一个通过文件或流式接口进行读写的通用设备连接对象。根据现有证据，无法可靠确定其对应的具体物理仪器型号；它更像是实验室仪器通信中使用的底层输入输出端点，用于向设备写入命令、读取返回数据并关闭连接。
parsed.description_en: This is a generic device connection exposed through a file or stream-style read/write interface. Based on the available evidence, the specific physical instrument cannot be identified reliably; it appears to be a low-level I/O endpoint used in laboratory instrument communication for writing commands, reading returned data, and closing the connection.
